title: Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for the Financial Year 1 April 2016 to 31 March 2017
what_it_is: Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for the Financial Year 1 April 2016 to 31 March 2017

sections.label: Supplementary Main Estimates expenditure heads
sections.summary: With no amendments, the Speaker proposes taking Heads of Expenditure en bloc, starting with Heads E, I, N and S of the Supplementary Main Estimates.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: As there are no amendments, I propose to take the Heads of Expenditure en bloc.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: I will first take Heads E, I, N and S of the Supplementary Main Estimates.
